description: Claude smoke set (c37, run with --engine claude on an API-KEY login; three conversations, four turns in all, the smallest real measurement). claude-plain: a one-word turn (timing: first event, first progress, final answer; the first real signal of the CLI's usage events). claude-two-turns: a second turn on the same Claude process (the answer must carry what turn one said: the conversation continues, the process is reused). claude-own-command: the engine path through EG-Desk's command tool and its approval over the adapter's MCP bridge (egdesk_run_command through the permission broker); needs --decisions (the "yes" approval is read by the Decision model). Not in the set, not applicable on Claude: action first (the own-tools mode is Codex only). Read the timing with: node scripts/egdesk-real-engine-timing.mjs table <out>/records.
